requests: The full Amalfi experience — Positano, Amalfi, Ravello, Capri, plus Pompeii and Sorrento. No rushing. 7 days covering the coast thoroughly with a split base: 2 nights Sorrento + 4 nights on the coast (Amalfi or Positano). Day-by-day: Day 1 arrive Naples, transfer to Sorrento, explore town, Vallone dei Mulini, limoncello tasting, dinner at Inn Bufalito. Day 2 Pompeii day trip via Circumvesuviana (allow 4hrs), afternoon explore Sorrento old town, sunset drinks at Bagni della Regina Giovanna. Day 3 transfer to Amalfi Coast base (Amalfi town), afternoon explore Amalfi Cathedral and Chiostro del Paradiso, walk to charming Atrani for aperitivo. Day 4 morning ferry to Positano, explore the colorful streets, Fornillo Beach for fewer crowds, lunch at Da Adolfo (boat shuttle from main beach), afternoon Path of the Gods hike from Bomerano to Nocelle (2.5hrs, stunning cliffside views), bus back. Day 5 Capri day trip - ferry from Amalfi, chairlift to Monte Solaro, Giardini di Augusto, Via Krupp views, Faraglioni rocks, optional Blue Grotto, lunch in Anacapri, return evening ferry. Day 6 morning bus to Ravello - Villa Rufolo gardens, Villa Cimbrone infinity terrace, lunch at Ristorante Salvatore with panoramic views. Afternoon Emerald Grotto visit, evening sunset dinner in Praiano at Kasai restaurant. Day 7 relaxed morning, optional boat tour along coast, transfer to Naples airport. Budget tips: SITA buses cheapest way around (2-3 EUR), ferries 10-20 EUR between towns, book Pompeii tickets online to skip lines, eat at trattorias away from waterfront for better prices, buy ferry day passes. Restaurant recs: Trattoria da Gemma (Amalfi, family-run since 1872), Le Sirenuse champagne bar (Positano, splurge for views), Da Vincenzo (Positano, excellent seafood), Lo Smeraldino (Amalfi, waterfront pizza), Cuomo (Ravello, locals favorite). Insider tips: visit Positano early morning or late afternoon to avoid cruise ship crowds, Atrani is the hidden gem next to Amalfi with better beaches and fewer tourists, Path of Gods best done west-to-east for views in front of you, Ravello concerts at Villa Rufolo in summer are magical.

requests: Reykjavik, Golden Circle, South Coast waterfalls, black sand beaches, and Blue Lagoon in 5 packed days. Include: Day 1 - Arrival in Reykjavik, explore downtown (Hallgrimskirkja, Laugavegur), dinner recommendations (Baejarins Beztu, Grillid). Day 2 - Golden Circle: Thingvellir National Park (UNESCO site, tectonic plates, Silfra snorkeling optional), Geysir geothermal area (Strokkur erupts every 5-10 min), Gullfoss waterfall, Kerid volcanic crater, Secret Lagoon in Fludir. Day 3 - South Coast: Seljalandsfoss (walk behind the waterfall), Gljufrabui (hidden waterfall nearby), Skogafoss (climb 527 steps for panoramic views), Solheimajokull glacier (glacier hike optional), Reynisfjara black sand beach (basalt columns, Reynisdrangar sea stacks, beware sneaker waves), overnight in Vik. Day 4 - Drive east to Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon (zodiac boat tour or kayak among icebergs), Diamond Beach (ice chunks on black sand), Skaftafell/Vatnajokull National Park (hike to Svartifoss basalt column waterfall), drive back to Vik or Selfoss area. Day 5 - Blue Lagoon (book in advance, silica mud mask, lava restaurant), depart from Keflavik. Budget tips: grocery stores Bonus/Kronan are cheapest, gas stations (N1, Olis) have decent hot dogs and lamb soup, rent a car (not SUV unless doing F-roads), book Blue Lagoon weeks ahead. Transport: rental car essential, Ring Road 1 is paved and easy, drive on the right, watch for single-lane bridges and sheep on roads. Insider tips: Sky Lagoon near Reykjavik is a less touristy alternative to Blue Lagoon with ocean views, Kvernufoss waterfall near Skogafoss is hidden and uncrowded, Fjadrargljufur canyon near Vik is stunning (30 min detour), best photo spots are early morning or late evening (golden hour lasts forever in summer). Weather: dress in layers, wind and rain are constant, waterproof outer layer essential.

Day 1: Arrive Lima — Miraflores malecón walk, Museo Larco, ceviche at La Mar. Evening in Barranco district with pisco sours.
Day 2: Lima food exploration — Mercado de Surquillo morning market, cooking class, explore Lima Centro (Plaza Mayor, San Francisco catacombs). Flight to Puerto Maldonado in the evening.
Day 3: Amazon jungle — boat ride into Tambopata National Reserve. Arrive at jungle lodge, afternoon nature walk, nighttime caiman spotting.
Day 4: Amazon jungle — early morning macaw clay lick visit, canopy walk, piranha fishing on oxbow lake. Evening wildlife spotting by boat.
Day 5: Morning jungle hike, boat back to Puerto Maldonado. Afternoon flight to Cusco. REST and acclimatize — coca tea, light walking around San Blas neighborhood. Stay hydrated.
Day 6: Sacred Valley day 1 — Pisac ruins and colorful market, drive to Ollantaytambo, explore the fortress ruins. Overnight in Ollantaytambo.
Day 7: Sacred Valley day 2 — Maras salt mines and Moray agricultural terraces in the morning. Afternoon at Chinchero weaving community. Train to Aguas Calientes in the evening.
Day 8: Machu Picchu — early morning entry (Circuit 1 for classic viewpoint), guided tour of the citadel, optional Huayna Picchu hike. Afternoon train to Ollantaytambo, transfer to Cusco.
Day 9: Cusco exploration — Plaza de Armas, Sacsayhuamán fortress, Qenqo ruins, San Pedro Market for lunch, chocolate museum, evening at Jack's Cafe or Cicciolina.
Day 10: Cusco to Puno — scenic bus ride (10 hours) through the Altiplano with stops at Andahuaylillas church (Sistine Chapel of the Americas), Raqchi temple, La Raya pass (4,335m). Arrive Puno.
Day 11: Lake Titicaca — morning boat to Uros floating reed islands, continue to Taquile Island for weaving culture and hilltop lunch. Return to Puno. Evening bus or colectivo to Arequipa (overnight or early morning).
Day 12: Arequipa — Santa Catalina Monastery, Plaza de Armas, local picanterías for rocoto relleno. Afternoon bus to Chivay (Colca Canyon gateway). Evening hot springs at La Calera.
Day 13: Colca Canyon — sunrise at Cruz del Condor viewpoint to watch Andean condors soar. Hike down to the canyon or explore terraced villages. Hot springs. Overnight in Chivay.
Day 14: Return to Arequipa, flight to Lima. Farewell ceviche lunch in Miraflores. Departure.

Include: altitude acclimatization advice (arrive Cusco Day 5, rest before big days), Cruz Del Sur bus recommendations, best restaurants in Lima (Central, Maido, La Mar, El Mercado), Tambopata lodge options (Refugio Amazonas, Tambopata Research Centre), Sacred Valley transport tips, Machu Picchu ticket booking advice (book 2+ months ahead for Huayna Picchu), packing tips for altitude + jungle. Budget: roughly -3000 per person excluding international flights.
